verdict.rationale: Llama's open-weight model can be run entirely locally/on-device (desktop, mobile, edge) per llama-docs-3, llama-docs-9, llama-docs-13, llama-docs-14, which inherently means no data is sent back to Meta for training when self-hosted. However, there is no explicit privacy policy, opt-out setting, or documented commitment addressing training-data usage for any hosted/cloud Llama offerings (e.g., Meta AI, partner clouds). missing for 10: explicit data-training opt-out policy, documented commitment on hosted-service data usage, first-party privacy statement.
